notes.title: Update Notes Version 1.5.1
notes.content:
Performance & Visual Improvements

[list]
[*] Capped framerate to reduce GPU overuse
[*] Lowered particle raycast budget to improve efficiency without sacrificing fire quality
[*] Adjusted quality settings to better suit low-poly visuals
[*] Better performance on high-end GPUs, laptops, and Steam Deck
[*] No visual changes — the fireplace stays just as cozy, now with less fan noise
[/list]

Thanks for the feedback and support, more updates to come!
— Kyle

notes.title: Japanese Language Now Fully Supported!
notes.content:
To all the incredible players in Japan — thank you for your support and enthusiasm for Virtual Interactive Fireplace. Your kind messages, videos, and creativity haven’t gone unnoticed.

I’m happy to announce that the game is now fully localized in Japanese!
You can access the language option anytime from the Settings menu.

This port was done with care as a thank-you to the growing Japanese community who embraced the game early on. I hope it adds a little extra warmth to your experience. 

Thank you for being part of this journey!

— Kyle

notes.title: Update Notes Version 1.4.1
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

I’m excited to share the latest update for Virtual Interactive Fireplace. Here’s what’s new in Version 1.4.1:

Bug Fixes and Performance Tweaks: 
Smoothed out a bunch of little issues to make everything run better.

New Fire Timer: 
Added a fire timer! It’ll come in handy for some cool features I’m working on for future updates.

Sound Effects for the Model Train: 
If you’ve got the Christmas Decor DLC, you’ll now hear some fun, immersive sounds from the little train circling your hearth!

Also, we just reached an incredible milestone: 45,000 users! Your support and feedback mean the world to me. I couldn’t have done it without you. As a solo developer, I’m truly grateful for each and every one of you who has downloaded the game, shared it, or purchased the DLCs. 

Got suggestions or want to share your thoughts? [url=https://discord.gg/vzbRuXdeRk]Join the conversation on Discord[/url]

Cheers,
- Kyle

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45293658/abf5323f7f59986e98bedbbabf542ba41f3ea342.png[/img]

notes.title: Update Notes: Version 1.3.1
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

What an incredible launch week—over 30,000 of you have downloaded Virtual Interactive Fireplace! I’m beyond grateful for the support and feedback from this amazing community. This has been a dream come true, and I’m so excited to keep making this project even better for all of you.

Here’s what’s new in v1.3.1:

What’s New?
Steam Achievements:
Achievements are finally here! Unlock milestones and surprises as you spend time by the fire.

Fire Sound Overhaul:
A big update to the fire sounds—now more realistic and immersive than ever. This change is directly thanks to your feedback, so a huge thank you for helping me make the fireplace even better!

Adjustable Windowed Mode:
You can now resize the game window to fit your setup. Fullscreen or windowed, it’s all about what works for you.

Thank You!
This has been an incredible week, and it’s all thanks to this community. Your ideas, feedback, and support are what keep this fire burning, and I can’t wait to share more updates and features with you in the future.

Got suggestions or want to share your thoughts? [url=https://discord.gg/FqWZxsNY]Join the conversation on Discord[/url]

Cheers,
- Kyle

notes.title: Update Notes: Version 1.3.0
notes.content:
This update introduces a major new feature:

Decor System 🪄
You can now customize your cozy scenes with a brand-new Decor System, allowing you to place and arrange items around your fireplace. In this update, we’ve added 8 fun items to get you started, bringing even more charm and personality to your virtual hearth.

This modular system is a big step forward and sets the foundation for many more decorative items coming in future updates. Get ready to make your fireplace as unique and inviting as you are!

Thank you for your continued support and feedback—it keeps this fire burning! 

As always, if you love the update, let us know by leaving a review or sharing your thoughts in the community!
